text: [ 142.85 MHz SHORTWAVE LOCKED · SOUTHERN SANDSTORM OVERRIDE... ]
"SILVIA! SILVIA, CAN YOU HEAR ME THROUGH THE STATIC? THE STORM IS RIGHT ON TOP OF ME OUT HERE IN THE DUNES!"
"THOSE WORDS... YOU SPOKE THE VOW I CARVED INTO THAT BRASS DIAL FIFTY-SIX YEARS AGO! AFTER A DECADE OF WATCHING THE DISTANT LIGHT... YOU GAVE ME BACK MY TRUE NAME!"
"I TRACKED THE RAIDERS DOWN INTO THE DESERT, BUT THIS RED SANDSTORM CAUGHT ME IN THE OPEN! THEY FLED DEEPER INTO THE SANDS WITH OUR STOLEN ASTROLABE!"
"THE GALE IS COLOSSAL—IT IS SEALING THE MOUNTAIN PASS BEHIND YOU! OUR JOURNEY OF MOUNTAIN NUMBERS IS FINISHED!"
"I MUST FIND SHELTER IN THE CANYON RUINS BEFORE THIS TEMPEST SWALLOWS ME WHOLE! WHEN THE WINDS FINALLY DIE DOWN, YOU MUST DESCEND INTO THE DESERT."
"OPEN THE NEXT SHEET OF MY JOURNAL! STUDY THE DESERT PATH—DOWN HERE, MOUNTAIN EQUATIONS HAVE NO POWER; ONLY THE ANCIENT LANGUAGES OF THE SAND CAN GUIDE YOU!"
"THE SAND IS RIPPING MY ANTENNA AWAY! THE CARRIER IS DYING! ONCE YOU REACH THE DESERT THRESHOLD, WE WILL FIND THE DESERT ORACLE TOGETHER AND RECOVER THE ASTROLABE!"
"HOLD YOUR GROUND UNTIL THE GALE CLEARS! I WILL BE WAITING FOR YOU AT THE EDGE OF THE SANDS!"
[ ANTENNA MAST TORN DOWN · CARRIER COLLAPSED · RECONNECT IN THE DESERT PATH ]
